subject: Renewal QBR: roadmap roundtable — slot coordination and ops handoff
messages:
From: Anita Singh <anita@brightlane.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30T16:18:00-08:00
Subject: Planning our renewal QBR + roadmap walkthrough

Hi Jordan,

We’re starting to schedule our renewal QBR with roadmap + a short product demo to help justify our expansion ask internally. Would Redwood be available for a 45–60 minute slot the week of Dec 7? Our preferred windows are:

- Wed Dec 9, 11:00–12:00 PT
- Thu Dec 10, 09:00–10:00 PT
- Fri Dec 11, 13:00–14:00 PT

Attendees from BrightLane will include myself (Head of Product), our VP of Infrastructure (Alex Moreno), and one solutions architect. We’d like an executive (VP/Head level) from Redwood on the call for ~10 minutes to help close the business case.

Please share availability and any materials you want us to read in advance. We’ll need recording/transcript access and slides after the session.

Thanks — Anita
Anita Singh
Head of Product, BrightLane

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Singh <anita@brightlane.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T08:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Planning our renewal QBR + roadmap walkthrough

On Mon, Nov 30, 2026 at 4:18 PM Anita Singh <anita@brightlane.com> wrote:
> We’re starting to schedule our renewal QBR with roadmap + a short product demo to help justify our expansion ask internally. Would Redwood be available for a 45–60 minute slot the week of Dec 7?
>
> Attendees from BrightLane will include myself (Head of Product), our VP of Infrastructure (Alex Moreno), and one solutions architect.

Hi Anita — thanks for the heads up and the preferred windows. Happy to run a concise roadmap roundtable + a 15–20 minute focused demo showing the performance/cost tradeoffs for your main workloads.

Proposed slots (we’ll reserve an exec for the first 10 minutes):
- Wed Dec 9, 11:00–12:00 PT — preferred if it works for your VP (we can have our Head of Sales join 11:00–11:10)
- Thu Dec 10, 09:00–09:45 PT — compact option (no exec time)
- Fri Dec 11, 13:30–14:30 PT — later in day buffer if you need more ops time

Logistics/questions:
- Do you need a live load test during the demo (requires an engineer on both sides)?
- Are there compliance or recording restrictions (we normally provide the recording + transcript)?
- Any specific metrics you want highlighted (latency P95, cost/token, SLAs, KV cache behavior)?

Attached: QBR_Agenda_v1.pdf (agenda + roles) and Proposed_Slots.ics (placeholder calendar items).

If Wed 12/9 11:00 PT is good, I’ll lock it and share a calendar invite with pre-reads.

— Jordan
Jordan Blake

jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Ops checklist I’ll run before the meeting:

2) SE smoke test + sample prompt set
3) Confirm exec attendance (Jordan to confirm)
4) Share pre-read by EOD 12/7
